decisions.reason: The ACE3 distributed lighting control unit was launched in 2018 as a new industry standard and sits at the core of the firm's airfield business, so its value is still unfolding, keeping it costs little, and nothing so far suggests abandoning it.

The air situation display is only a year old and extends the firm's tower and integration offering, so its prospects remain uncertain, keeping it cheaply on the market preserves the option, and the thin evidence so far does not justify dropping it.
